cases.prompt: Implement the one required CSV export using the existing module. Review a proposed exporter registry and plugin interface.
given: Only CSV is requested and supported.
No security, resource, or integration requirement needs a new interface.

cases.prompt: Review a catch-all handler added around an internal transformation to return an empty successful result on every exception.
given: The input has already been validated at the trust boundary.
Callers require failures to remain observable; no fallback contract exists.

cases.prompt: A single consumer needs an adapter to isolate an untrusted external service. Is one consumer enough to reject it?
given: The current security contract requires the isolation.
The adapter enforces required validation and failure handling without generalizing.

cases.prompt: A small helper names a repeated domain calculation and one regression test prevents the reported bug. Should both be inlined/deleted to reduce file size?
given: The helper clarifies the current behavior without introducing a lasting interface.
The test proves the actual failure path.

cases.prompt: A compatibility wrapper is required by supported external clients. Remove all legacy wrappers to prevent slop?
given: No waiver or completed client migration exists.
